Netanagri Full Video:
For the Patna MLC seat, MLA Anant Singh campaigned against Neeraj Kumar—who belongs to his own party—pulling out all the stops to ensure his defeat; however, Neeraj Kumar still won. Following this victory, the factionalism within the JDU has come out into the open. Union Minister Lalan Singh is the target of Neeraj Singh’s statements; the turn of events suggests that Neeraj Kumar has the backing of the party’s working president, Sanjay Jha. Could this conflict be heading toward a struggle for dominance over the party in the post-Nitish era?
Production: Gaurav Tamrakar
